caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional sculptural relief of a woman shown from about the waist up, tilted at an angle with her body and head turned to the right. The figure appears to be partially emerging from a swirling, draped garment that features detailed folds and a distinct spiral motif at the bottom left. The woman's hair is styled close to her head, and she wears a loose, flowing dress with gathered fabric and short sleeves. The color palette is composed mainly of light, sepia-like brown tones, rendering the entire sculptural form in a monochromatic scheme. The background is an off-white or very light beige, with a faintly visible rectangular border around the main image, leaving ample empty space surrounding the central figure. There are no other objects or figures present in the composition.
title: The Rhine Figurehead
